svg.text: R-101 BOILING POINT AT 30 bar g
FAIL POSITION FC CLOSED / FO OPEN
ON/OFF VALVE WITH SOLENOID (SIS, EIV, HY)
MANUAL GATE VALVE (NO / NC / LO = NORMALLY
SERVICE: P PROCESS LIQUID / TWO-PHASE · G HYDROGEN GAS
SL SLURRY (Raney-Ni) · BW BOILER FEED WATER · LS LP STEAM
MS MP STEAM · CD CONDENSATE · BD BLOWDOWN · CW COOLING
WATER · FL FLARE · N NITROGEN. NNNN: 1nnn SHEET 1, 2nnn SHEET 2
TAGS: MV MANUAL VALVE · NRV CHECK VALVE · HV OPERATOR
HAND VALVE OF THE OTS · HY VALVE MOVED BY A DCS SELECTOR
NOT IN THE OTS MODEL: HOLD FOR APPROVAL
1 DESIGN CASE = OTS MODEL AT DESIGN, NOISE OFF: benzene 34.8 t/h (0.1238 kmol/s), R-101 200 °C / 30.0 bar g, 98 % conversion in R-101,
E-101 9.6 MW raising 14.7 t/h LP steam at 4.5 bar g, boil-up condensed in E-103 and refluxed (46.5 t/h at 55.7 °C). Balances checked in
eng_check.py before drawing: total 37.78 t/h in = out (+0.01 %), H2 and CH4 within 0.01 %, R-101 heat 25.2 MW generated vs 25.1 MW
2 LINE SIZES ARE PRELIMINARY, FROM VELOCITY (liquid suction ≤ 1–2 m/s, discharge ≤ 2–2.5 m/s, gas ≤ 12–15 m/s, steam ≤ 30 m/s; typical
practice). TBC by hydraulic calculation; pipe classes not assigned (HOLD).
3 HYDROGEN LOOP DESIGN PRESSURE 36 bar g (assumed, Safety layers tab) = PSV-101 set; R-101 design temperature 250 °C (assumed). Relief
4 FIELD TRANSMITTERS (circle) are wired to the DCS (circle with bar) and, where drawn, separately to the SIS logic solver SIS-100 (circle
in square). SIS outputs to XV / EIV solenoids and motor starters are not drawn: see the interlock schedule on sheet 2.
5 TE-100 / TT-100 (SIS) and TE-101 / TT-101 (BPCS) are separate elements in separate thermowells. TIC-101 is the master of FIC-104
(cascade). FV-104 is three-way: the rest of the P-101 flow bypasses E-101.
6 HS-101 (DCS selector) COOL: HY-101A/B open (E-101 shell on the D-101 thermosyphon), HY-101C/D shut. HEAT: HY-101A/B shut, HY-101C/D open,
MP steam set by the operator on HV-110. A unit trip forces COOL (HY-101D shuts the MP steam: in the OTS model the trip closes HV-110).
HY-101A-D and ST-101 are new tags of this drawing (HOLD: arrangement TBC).
7 ITEMS MARKED * are recommended additions from the Safety layers tab (SL-Rn), not in the OTS model: HOLD. Further SRS / LOPA
recommendations not drawn: LSLL-101 on LT-101S, FSLL-103 on FT-103S, AT-100B, XV-105B, TSHH-107S on TE-107S, PIAH-101 (32.5 bar g on
8 MV-3nn and NRV-3nn are new numbers of this drawing (sheet 2: MV-4nn, NRV-4nn). Every pump has suction and discharge isolation and a
discharge check valve. Pressure and level instruments c/w root, isolation and test valves (typ., not shown).
9 R-101 has no vent of its own: it is vented through E-103 / V-103 and the R-102 off-gas line to flare (HV-121, EDV-101, sheet 2). No
isolation valve between R-101 and PSV-101.
10 Raney-Ni is pyrophoric: D-102 charged under liquid with an N2 blanket (CAT-1); HV-117 is opened only with D-102 full of liquid.
11 THE SCREEN P&ID OF THE OTS PAGE stays the reference for the DCS, the decks and the exercises. Where this drawing places an instrument
differently it is listed as a difference (P&ID tab, alternative version, part 5), not as an error.
